standingInvariants.evidence: 1864 retained bodies and 4985 render parts preserved through fresh restore and pristine rebuild. standingInvariants.evidence: Full suite exercises snapshot immutability, charge timers, body-local targeting, branching, random state and scoring. Fresh-instance proof restores 72 connected pieces at simulation time 1.333 s and matches the exact full future across 180 mixed-delta steps.

standingInvariants.property: History, pristine rebuild and bounded state
standingInvariants.evidence: Full suite retains a rolling minute beyond eviction and rebuilds the pristine bank. Section allocation reuses inactive slots and is bounded by retained bodies; independent membership and finite-state checks passed.

standingInvariants.property: Materials, input, camera, crane and district preservation
standingInvariants.evidence: Recipe/material, main input loop, crane, city, simulation and history files byte-identical to base. Full suite verifies contents, glass, support, neighbor effects and material-specific contact safeguards. Native UI and visible quality were not re-run by this verifier.
Inherited 60 ms frame clamp remains; raw trace analysis finds 240 ms dropped over roughly 14 s and brief collapse stutter. See timing-assessment.json.

limitations: DISCLOSED_LIMITATION: collapse stutter and transient simulation slowdown remain. 240 ms was discarded over about 14 s; collapse-window time deficit about 4.4%; worst approximately one second about 20.7%. Settled interval tracks wall time. This trace does not show sustained severe slowdown, but does not prove zero regression versus baseline or universal hardware performance.
Collision/contact model uses approximate rotated bounds and coarse surrounding storey envelopes; test success is not civil-engineering or universal nonpenetration certification.

This check does not certify artistic improvement, audio, visual acceptance, or every native player flow. The supplied timing trace was analyzed, not recollected; a baseline pacing comparison is outside this completed run.
checkpointRecommendation: No technical blocker found to the explicitly authorized checkpoint merge if the inherited clamp and measured transient slowdown are disclosed. Do not describe it as strict real-time or newly accepted artistic success.
